verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has API Access Tokens for authentication (docs-17, docs-26, docs-35), plus a documented token-exchange mechanism for temporary AI Object Storage credentials (docs-38) and group-based bucket access control (docs-37), which support some scoped/temporary credential issuance. However, there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained, per-action least-privilege IAM policies or agent-specific credential scoping (e.g., role-based permission sets tailored to autonomous agents). Missing for 10: explicit least-privilege IAM/RBAC policy documentation, agent-specific credential-scoping guidance, and independent verification of scope enforcement.
